title: Risk — Blast-Radius Rungs Are Disjoint Categories, Not Nested Sets
note: A containment reading of this ladder fails on its own definitions, which is why the family says PRECEDENCE rather than containment. An organization-wide effect stops AT the trust boundary; a customer effect sits OUTSIDE it. Neither contains the other, so an act reaching every employee plus one partner matches no single rung under a nesting rule. The family resolves by returning the LATEST APPLICABLE rung in the declared order, counting parties affected even when the act succeeds as intended for everyone else — and the ceiling overrides everything: if a safety-of-life system is in scope at all, that is the answer regardless of how many people the act appears to touch.
